title: Turning off 'Share which machines I use' keeps what was already sent at the gym
what: While a gym has Busy machines on, the phone sends which of the gym's machines the member used, with the day and hour, for the last 35 days. When the member turns 'Share which machines I use' off, the phone only stops sending more. The rows already sent stay on the gym's server (kept up to 63 days) and keep feeding the gym's busy-times guesses. The other two sharing switches on the same page (gym mates, trainers) delete the gym's copy at once when turned off.
expected: Turning the switch off also asks the gym to delete this member's machine rows at once, the same as the other sharing switches, or the caption says what was already sent stays.
who: members of gyms with Busy machines on
how_often: every time the switch is turned off
fix_line: When the switch goes off, send one call that deletes this member's machine rows at the gym, and send it again later if there is no signal

title: Ask an AI always asks how to get stronger, and leaves out the member's sore areas and goal
what: The text shared to an AI app always ends with the same question: what to change to keep getting stronger. It never says the member's goal, and never says the sore areas or the exercises the member asked to leave out when building a plan, even though the app keeps those answers and uses them itself when it suggests a swap. So an AI can suggest heavy squats to a member who said their knees hurt, or strength work to a member whose goal is losing fat.
expected: The AI text carries the sore areas, the exercises to leave out and the goal (none of them identify the member), so the AI's ideas respect them.
who: members who use Ask an AI after building a plan with sore areas
how_often: every time the text is shared
fix_line: Add one short line with the goal, sore areas and left-out exercises from the followed plan before the question, and word the question by goal

title: The page with the machine and trainer sharing switches can only be opened while the gym's leaderboard answers
what: Settings shows the 'What my gym can see' row only after the gym's leaderboard has answered in this app session, and the page itself hides the gym mates and machine switches until then. The leaderboard counts as not there when the gym's plan has no monthly challenge (a paid part), when the phone was offline at the first ask, or after a server error. Today every gym has the challenge because the plan gate is off, so this only bites offline. Once the gate is on, a gym on a plan without the challenge but with Busy machines or the trainer view leaves its members with no way to turn off 'Share which machines I use' or 'Share my workouts with my trainers', and the trainer one is on by default.
expected: The row and the page show whenever the member has any sharing switch that applies (leaderboard name, gym mates, machines, trainers), each switch shown on its own condition.
who: gym members, mainly at gyms on a plan without the monthly challenge
how_often: every time once the plan gate is on; today only while the leaderboard has not answered
fix_line: Show the row and page when any sharing switch applies, and gate each switch on its own feature, not on the leaderboard

title: A deleted workout still counts toward the gym's workout offer
what: After each saved workout the phone tells the gym the days that count toward the gym's workout offer. The gym only ever adds days. When the member deletes a workout, the phone tells the leaderboard, health apps and widgets, but not the offer, and has no way to take a day back, so the deleted workout's day keeps counting toward the reward. The gym still needs a check-in on that day, so the member was at the gym.
expected: Deleting a workout also re-sends the offer's days, and the gym drops a day the phone no longer counts (until the reward is earned).
who: members in a workout offer who delete a workout
how_often: each time such a workout is deleted
fix_line: After a delete, send the offer's full day list and let the gym replace the days it holds for an offer not yet earned
